integrity: The upper estimate is reconstructed from the unit-pair representation and triangle inequality. Pointwise sharpness for every ratio is witnessed explicitly in l_infinity^2, and the equality criterion follows by tracing equality through every step of the sharp bound. The bundled rational checker validates the explicit family but is not used as proof of the continuum statement. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result gives the exact universal envelope conditioned on the single chord ratio rho and classifies individual pairs attaining 9/4. It does not classify Banach spaces whose supremum 9/4 is not attained, nor all maximizers for fixed rho away from 1/2.
title: Sharp chord-imbalance envelope for the isosceles Dunkl--Williams integrand
